resources.string:
Attention Stats counts the short videos you watch in Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok and Snapchat, and how long you spend in them, so you can see and shape your habits.

While one of those apps is open, it reads the screen's layout and on-screen labels in memory to recognise a short-video player or feed video and to tell one video from the next. It does not read other apps, does not record, save or send what you watch, type or message, and keeps only counts and times, encrypted on this phone.

It shows a small counter on top of short videos. Only if you turn them on, it shows break reminders, presses Back to leave a short-video player you chose to block, or swipes to the next video (auto-scroll).

Nothing ever leaves your device. You can pause counting, turn off any app or delete everything in Attention Stats.
Short videos, watching time, screen time or breaks: you choose
